_comment: What each test card does. 'outcome' is one of: approve, decline, unavailable (503 before processing), slow (processes, then answers after delay_seconds), reject (capture only). 'affected_attempts' counts attempts per idempotency key, so a later retry with the same key behaves normally.

4000000000000101.description: Authorize succeeds but the answer is slow for the first 2 attempts (the API times out). A client retry with the same Idempotency-Key gets the original result.

4000000000000200.description: Authorize answers 503 without processing for the first 2 attempts. A client retry with the same Idempotency-Key succeeds.

4000000000000309.description: Authorize succeeds but the answer never arrives in time (every attempt is slow). Nobody can capture without the payment id: the order expires and its stock is released.

4000000000000408.description: The provider is down for authorize: always 503.

4000000000000507.description: Authorize works. Capture succeeds but the answer is slow for the first 2 attempts: the order stays AUTHORIZED and the reconciler captures it.

4000000000000606.description: Authorize works but the capture is rejected (the hold is gone): the order fails and its stock is released.

4000000000000705.description: Authorize works but capture always answers 503. The order stays AUTHORIZED, never expires, and the reconciler keeps retrying the capture.
